data.title: 不知火舞 · 夏祭折扇与苹果糖
data.description: 【乡镇夏祭·夜】不知火舞穿着红白浴衣站在苹果糖摊前，折扇轻轻挡住被糖浆黏住的手指；她把刚挑好的苹果糖递向镜头，红白灯笼映出高马尾和明朗笑容。
data.action: 苹果糖摊前用折扇解开黏住的手指，再把亮晶晶的糖果递向镜头
data.lighting: warm lantern light under the night sky
data.mood: 不知火流继承人的轻快祭典
data.promptProse: Mai Shiranui from Fatal Fury wears a modest red-and-white floral yukata with an opaque inner collar and a dark obi. She stands beneath the festival lanterns with a red apple candy and her folding fan. She uses the fan to rescue a sticky fingertip, then presents the glossy treat toward the viewer, her high ponytail and bright smile moving with the warm night crowd. warm lantern light under the night sky.
